controls.title: Secure Architecture & Gateway Segregation
controls.description: Payment gateway keys and webhook secrets must be stored strictly server-side and never bundled in client code.

controls.title: Business Logic Integrity Model
controls.description: All financial calculations (gross, fees, item allocation totals) must be computed or re-validated authoritatively by the server.

controls.title: Secure Password Hashing
controls.description: User and admin credentials must be hashed using strong one-way cryptographic algorithms with salt (e.g., bcrypt/Argon2/scrypt).

controls.title: Brute Force & Credential Stuffing Defenses
controls.description: Login endpoints must enforce rate limiting and progressive delays to prevent brute-force attacks.

controls.title: Secure Cookie Flags
controls.description: Session cookies must specify HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite (Lax or Strict) attributes.

controls.title: Session Termination
controls.description: Logout must completely invalidate the session both client-side and server-side.

controls.title: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
controls.description: Administrative actions (campaign approvals, user management, recognition badges) must enforce staff/admin role checks.

controls.title: Insecure Direct Object References (IDOR)
controls.description: Donation orders and receipts must ensure that one donor cannot view or alter another donor's private records without authorization.

controls.title: Input Type & Range Validation
controls.description: Donation amounts must be positive integers above minimum threshold; email addresses and PAN format must be validated.

controls.title: Output Encoding & XSS Prevention
controls.description: User-supplied text (campaign titles, donor messages) must be contextually encoded before rendering to prevent XSS.

controls.title: Timing-Safe Signature Comparison
controls.description: Cryptographic signature comparisons (Razorpay HMAC-SHA256) must use constant-time comparisons (crypto.timingSafeEqual).

controls.title: Key Isolation & Redaction
controls.description: API keys and secrets must never be committed to source code or logged in plaintext.

controls.title: Sanitized Error Messages
controls.description: Application endpoints must not expose internal stack traces, database schema details, or raw exception objects to callers.

controls.title: Redaction of Sensitive PII and Secrets in Logs
controls.description: Logs must not record donor PAN numbers, credit card data, auth tokens, or webhook signatures.

controls.title: Donor Privacy / Anonymous Giving
controls.description: When a donor selects anonymous giving, their name, email, and phone must not be rendered publicly in feeds or API responses.

controls.title: PAN Card Confidentiality
controls.description: Donor PAN cards collected for 80G tax benefit compliance must be masked or restricted strictly to authorized tax admins.

controls.title: Strict Transport Security (HSTS)
controls.description: All HTTP traffic must be redirected to HTTPS with HSTS headers in production.

controls.title: Dependency Vulnerability Auditing
controls.description: All third-party packages must be scanned continuously for known CVEs using npm audit and Trivy.

controls.title: Server-Side Razorpay Signature Verification
controls.description: Payment completion must strictly require valid HMAC-SHA256 signature verification computed server-side.

controls.title: Webhook Idempotency & Replay Resistance
controls.description: Webhook events (payment.captured, refund.processed) must be idempotent; replayed events must not result in duplicated credits.

controls.title: Client Price & Item Quantity Tamper Resistance
controls.description: The client must not be able to alter unit prices or donate less than the sum of allocated item needs.

controls.title: Upload MIME Type & Size Validation
controls.description: File uploads (logos, campaign images) must enforce allowed image MIME types, extensions, and file size limits.

controls.title: HTTP Method Enforcement & Payload Limits
controls.description: API routes must restrict allowed HTTP methods and reject oversized or malformed JSON payloads.

controls.title: HTTP Security Headers
controls.description: Responses must include Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, and Referrer-Policy.

controls.title: CORS Policy Restriction
controls.description: Access-Control-Allow-Origin must not specify wildcard '*' with credentials allowed.
